require("FairyGUI.FairyBase")

---InitFairy
function InitFairy()
    print("InitFairy ==================================")
end

---@alias PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle fun(packageName:string):void

---@type PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle[]
local packagedLoadedHandlers = {}

---@type PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle[]
local packagedUnloadHandlers = {}

---@param packageName string
function OnFairyPackageLoaded(packageName)
    for _, fun in ipairs(packagedLoadedHandlers) do
        fun(packageName)
    end
end

---@param packageName string
function OnFairyPackageUnload(packageName)
    for _, fun in ipairs(packagedUnloadHandlers) do
        fun(packageName)
    end
end

---AddFairyPackageLoadedHandle
---@param handle PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle
function AddFairyPackageLoadedHandle(handle)
    table.insert(packagedLoadedHandlers, handle)
    local loadedPackages = FairyGUI.UIPackage.GetPackages()
    local count = loadedPackages.Count
    if count <= 0 then return end
    for i = 0, count - 1 do
        local pkg = loadedPackages[i]
        handle(pkg.name)
    end
end

---RemoveFairyPackageLoadedHandle
---@param handle PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle
function RemoveFairyPackageLoadedHandle(handle)
    for i = #packagedLoadedHandlers, 1, -1 do
        if packagedLoadedHandlers[i] == handle then
            return table.remove(packagedLoadedHandlers, i)
        end
    end
end

---AddFairyPackageUnloadHandle
---@param handle PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle
function AddFairyPackageUnloadHandle(handle)
    table.insert(packagedUnloadHandlers, handle)
end

---RemoveFairyPackageUnloadHandle
---@param handle PackageLoadedOrUnloadHandle
function RemoveFairyPackageUnloadHandle(handle)
    for i = #packagedUnloadHandlers, 1, -1 do
        if packagedUnloadHandlers[i] == handle then
            return table.remove(packagedUnloadHandlers, i)
        end
    end
end
